Run one file operation and send the result file(s) to __JC_OWNER_CALL__ in the chat they are using. operation: exact name from pdf_operations. params: JSON object of parameters (only the ones you need; required ones with defaults are filled automatically). files: refs separated by spaces, in order: f12 (files from the chat, see recent_files or the [file attached ...] line in their message) or doc:7 (archive documents from find_documents).
